item.title: Accelerating Construction of the Hung Vuong – Nguyen Tat Thanh – Phu Dong – Au Co Connection Road
item.description: The project to construct a connecting road from Hung Vuong Street through Nguyen Tat Thanh and Phu Dong Streets to Au Co Street spans over 3.7 km with a total investment of more than 445 billion VND. Implemented during the 2022–2026 period, the project has largely completed items such as sidewalks, street lighting, and greenery. Currently, the contractor is laying asphalt on the section from the Nguyen Tat Thanh intersection to Au Co Street, which is expected to be finished within March 2026.

item.title: Developing the People of the Ancestral Land in the New Era of Growth
item.description: Phu Tho, the ancestral heartland of the Vietnamese nation, has long been regarded as the cradle of the country’s unique historical and cultural values. Beyond preserving precious heritages from the Hung Kings era, this land serves as a confluence of diverse cultural streams, forging a distinct identity for the people of the Ancestral Land: patriotic, unified, grateful, and driven by an aspiration for progress.
